dedupe_keys.name: oxygen storage during power outages at jinja regional referral hospital uganda trial data

description: This data set comes from a trial of a low-pressure oxygen store that keeps oxygen flowing to patients when the electricity supply to a hospital's oxygen concentrator fails. The producers are Ryan Calderon and colleagues from Bellevue Hospital Center in New York, the University of California San Francisco and Jinja Regional Referral Hospital in Uganda, where the prototype was tested. Coverage is a 75-day non-clinical trial at Jinja, during which 1,284 power failures were recorded, lasting 3.1 minutes on average and up to 1,720 minutes; the store supplied oxygen for 56 percent of the 4,295 outage minutes and covered over 99 percent of outage events. The spreadsheets give power supply and outage records and oxygen delivery performance at flow rates adjusted weekly between 0.5 and 5 litres per minute. They are available as a free download from Dryad, mirrored on Zenodo, under the CC0 public domain dedication. Caveats: one hospital and one prototype, no patients were connected, and the files have little column documentation beyond the PLOS ONE article. Simulation uses: quantifying how grid unreliability cascades into loss of critical medical services, sizing back-up oxygen and power for health facilities, and calibrating outage duration distributions for hospitals in low-income countries. Related records: the Lacor Hospital power data (data-lacor-hospital-energy-community-power) record another Ugandan hospital's supply and demand.
name: Oxygen storage during power outages at Jinja Regional Referral Hospital, Uganda (trial data)
provider: Ryan Calderon, Melissa C. Morgan, Mark Kuiper, Harriet Nambuya, Nicholas Wangwe and Akos Somoskovi (Bellevue Hospital Center, UCSF, Jinja Hospital)
schema_summary: Power supply records and outage episodes, oxygen system performance (flow and delivery) and cumulative distributions of power and performance, from a prototype low-pressure oxygen store fed by a concentrator
